name: Ramble
description: A gallery-led travel concept with three imagined landscapes, animated journey browsing, complete journey pages, and a date-aware local trip planner.

notes.layout: compact left-aligned introduction, horizontal landscape gallery, pace selector, journey pages, separate trip planner
notes.motion: native scroll-snap gallery, active-image transitions, Web Animations API arrivals and state changes, reduced-motion support
notes.interaction: browse journeys by swipe or keyboard, filter landscapes, choose pace, create a dated trip draft, edit and download it
notes.provenance: Original six-page travel concept informed by destination-planning research. Own gallery composition, motion, copy, generated landscapes, and local planner. No reference source or assets included.
